name: SocialLinks
description: Links to the site's profiles on other networks as marks, names or both. The network is read from each address's host (the table Team uses), so a link carries only its address; an unknown host is shown as itself. Stands alone in a header, top bar, contact section or author box.

display.description: Mark only (named for assistive technology), the network's name, or both.

size.description: Mark and touch target size (32, 40 and 48 px minimum).

align.description: Where the row sits in its container.

shape.description: Bare marks, or each in a ringed circle.

links.description: The profiles; `label` only for a link whose host names no network (a personal site, "Newsletter").

name.description: Whose profiles these are, for "{name} on {network}".

label.description: Accessible name of the list (ui-strings social.label).

profileLabel.description: How each link announces itself; {name} and {network} are replaced (ui-strings social.profile).

a11y: A labelled list of links; each link's accessible name is "{name} on {network}" and always contains the visible text; marks are aria-hidden; links open in a new tab with rel=me noopener; every target is at least 32 px.
